anomaly_pixel_auroc — SPC anomaly_eval op

• Data kinds: video × video → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.anomaly_pixel_auroc(scores, masks) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import anomeval; anomeval.anomaly_pixel_auroc(scores, masks), registry से लेना हो तो opsspc.get("anomaly_pixel_auroc"))

उपयोग

anomaly score maps और ground-truth defect masks से pixel-level AUROC (table)।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

scores and masks are (n, H, W) (or lists / single 2-D maps); higher score = more anomalous. Exact Mann–Whitney statistic with mid-ranks for ties: the probability that a random defect pixel outscores a random good pixel, ties counting 1/2. Returns auroc, n_pos, n_neg.

Raises ValueError on empty / mismatched / non-finite input, non-binary masks, or when the masks contain no defect pixel or no good pixel (AUROC undefined).
